properties.segmentMeaning: continental shelf delimitation; from 1987 also EEZ delimitation
properties.coordinateSystemNote: Coordinates are preserved exactly in the treaty chart coordinate system. No datum shift is silently applied.
properties.note: The treaty expressly leaves the further westward segment from 43°20′43″ N, 32°00′00″ E toward 43°26′59″ N, 31°20′48″ E unsettled; that gap is not drawn.
